test_title: PYST 58: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  on 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Can we go visit a Statue of Liberty on our trip to the United States?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the correct article to use is 'the' instead of 'a' because Statue of Liberty is a **specific monument.**
 
• The correct sentence should be: *Can we go visit the Statue of Liberty on our trip to the United States?*
 
• Usage of the article 'a' implies any statue of liberty, which is incorrect as there is only one specific Statue of Liberty.

Hence, the correct statement is '***Can we go visit the __Statue of Liberty on our trip to the United States?**'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The definite article 'the' is used when referring to something specific or unique.
 
• For instance,*** The*** Eiffel Tower, ***The*** Great Wall of China, ***The*** Taj Mahal.
